memory_candidates.content: When auditing on-disk-vs-indexed state in notmuch, never use a default (excluded-tag-honoring) `notmuch search`/`count`/`--output=files` as the 'indexed set' side of a diff. notmuch's `search.exclude_tags` config (commonly deleted/spam/trash) causes ALL default search/count/output-files invocations to silently omit matching messages, even though they are fully indexed. This produces false 'unindexed' positives for any excluded-tag message when diffed against on-disk file lists. Use `--exclude=false`, an explicit `(tag:X or not tag:X)` construction, or a non-tag-filtered `notmuch count 'path:<folder>'` as the indexed-side ground truth instead.

xapian-check (read-only, no --fix) via `nix shell nixpkgs#xapian` is a safe, ephemeral way to verify Xapian glass-backend B-tree integrity (docdata, termlist, postlist, position tables) before assuming a 'ghost' or 'stuck' directory-bookkeeping record exists. Confirming DB health first can rule out a Xapian-level explanation entirely and redirect diagnosis toward notmuch-config-level causes (e.g. search.exclude_tags) instead of assuming index corruption.
